### Dead Stumps Grow Back and Thrive, and so Can You - Encouragement for Today - January 5, 2021
Author: Tracie Miles
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-january-5-2021.html
Passage: Job 14:7
Points:
- Severe trials and losses can leave a person feeling discarded and cut down like a dead tree stump.
- Job experienced overwhelming grief and hardship, yet he brought his sorrow before God instead of walking away from Him.
- Just as a severed stump can unexpectedly sprout green shoots, hope remains possible even after profound devastation.
- Holding onto faith serves as essential spiritual water and sunlight, allowing new life to emerge from despair.
- God remains faithful in the midst of suffering and possesses the power to bring healing and restoration.

### Failure is Not Final - Girlfriends in God - April 28, 2014
Author: Mary Southerland
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/failure-is-not-final-girlfriends-in-god-april-28-2014.html
Passage: Job 14:7
Points:
- Experiencing mistakes and shortcomings is inevitable, but failure does not have to be the final chapter.
- Prominent biblical figures repeatedly fell short, yet their failures became catalysts for spiritual maturity.
- Like a cut-down tree that retains the ability to produce fresh shoots, believers can experience renewal through God's grace.
- Moments of acute desperation can drive people to crave the Lord and depend fully on His power.
- When surrendered to God, painful setbacks can be transformed into opportunities for triumph and growth.
